node.statement: By lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities there is a universal e_cmp>0 for the amplified compression identities, and by lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared there is a universal e_col>0 for the amplified column-Hilbert estimate. Set e_var=min(e_cmp,e_col)>0, and fix an arbitrary H-CB datum with e<=e_var together with n>=1 and Z,X,Y as quantified in node 1.
